title: It will exceed your expectations
text: Alex was really amazing not only showing us the amazing towns in Costa Brava, also sharing the culture and traditions. Barnes and Tossa Del Mar really incredible but the food!! Really good. We were expecting only one dish and we got a four-course menu.  In general wonderful

title: Wonderful complete Costa Brava day!
text: A day with fantastic views, beaches, and swimming in places we couldn't reach without our own car. We were going to visit Barcelona but think this day in Costa Brava was the best day. Our guide Carma was knowledgeable, nice, and competent.

title: A rainy day in costa brava
text: Rebecca and Miguel were great. Rebecca especially was outstanding

title: Excellent Day Trip from Barcelona
text: This an excellent trip. Good amount of time at each location and all locations were beautiful and picturesque. The company the tour is with was wonderful. I would book again!

title: Incredible experience!

We also had a very safe drive, thanks to the driver, Miguel. i travlled solo and i felt very safe with the team. i definitely recommend this to anyone who is around Barcelona. title: Very good and amazing tour!

author: marcellal792

title: Amazing Day!! Great Guide!
text: Alex our tour guide was GREAT!!!  He was great at keeping a balance of giving information, keeping us on time and also giving us our own time to explore!  Even during the long periods on the bus he was great at giving us information and sharing stories about local culture and festivities!   The botanical gardens were really nice to walk thru and the beach was amazing!  Tossa de Mar was Beautiful with the walled city and nice shops!  Thank you for an amazing work experience!! If you go I strongly recommend requesting Alex!
author: wbrosha

title: Exceptional tour
text: Alex was super. He was so enthusiastic and kept everyone involved. This was one of the best tours I have been on in a while. Highly recommend this trip. Ask for Alex.
